questions.q: When you think of a time you truly felt loved, what did it feel like?
questions.answer: One example: when a friend really listened on a hard day instead of trying to fix it. I felt seen and cared for, which is how the lesson says others should feel when we love them.

questions.q: When you share your faith, do you want to be right or to love?
questions.answer: Honestly, it's tempting to want to win. But the lesson says all our knowledge is worth nothing without love, so the goal is caring for the person, not beating their argument.

questions.q: How could you show someone Jesus by the way you listen to them?
questions.answer: One example: asking a friend about their story and really listening before sharing mine. The lesson says taking a real interest is being like Jesus; some may only see Him that way.
